_README: These moved OUT of config/pulse.json deliberately. The pulse emits the raw signal and
forms no opinion about it; the watchdog reads these numbers verbatim and decides. The
watchdog has NO code path that derives a threshold from historical data — if it could
learn its own trigger point, the split would be cosmetic, because the process that
computes the escalation would once again be tuning the escalation.
composite_move_min   absolute change in the goal composite that warrants proposing a
whether a model_anomaly whose penumbra leaf hash VERIFIES against
the chain warrants proposing. An unverified hash never does.
min_gap_minutes      do not re-propose within this window; the supervisor separately
enforces a 4h gap between actual extraordinary STARTS.
